passage:
Dear Mr. Patel,

We are pleased to inform you that your lease for Apartment 3B, Greenfield Heights will be up for renewal on November 30th, 2025. Over the past year, your tenancy has been exemplary, and we greatly appreciate the care and respect you have shown toward the property. Given your excellent record as a responsible and reliable tenant, we are delighted to offer you a renewal term of 12 months at the same rental rate of $1,450 per month, with no increase in rent.

Enclosed with this message is the updated lease agreement outlining the terms and conditions for the upcoming rental period. We kindly request that you review the document carefully and return a signed copy to the leasing office by November 10th, 2025, to ensure a seamless continuation of your residency. Early submission will also allow us to make any necessary administrative updates before the new lease term begins.

Should you wish to discuss any modifications to your lease, such as changes in lease duration, pet policies, or utilities, or if you are interested in exploring available upgrades to apartment amenities, our leasing office staff is readily available to assist you. We are committed to ensuring that your living experience remains comfortable and enjoyable, and we welcome your input on ways we can further enhance your apartment and the community at large.

Greenfield Heights takes pride in fostering a welcoming and well-maintained community, and your continued residency contributes significantly to the positive environment we strive to provide. We value the relationship we have built with you over the past year and look forward to maintaining this partnership for another lease term.

If you have any questions regarding the lease renewal process, required documentation, or payment procedures, please do not hesitate to contact the leasing office at your convenience.

We sincerely appreciate your continued residency and cooperation and look forward to another year of shared commitment and a harmonious living experience at Greenfield Heights.

Warm regards,
Jennifer Liu
Leasing Manager
Greenfield Heights
